# DropSpace v0.3.0-preview.9 — Shell intake, Custom Quick Actions, and Undo

<!-- update-summary: Preview.9 adds source-safe Explorer and SendTo intake, capability-driven Custom Quick Actions, and one eight-second Undo slot while preserving local-first storage, Windows 10 compatibility, and the existing Dynamic Island architecture. -->

Preview.9 makes DropSpace easier to send content into, easier to personalize,
and safer to operate. The release keeps the existing Temporary Space,
Clipboard, Dynamic Island, Smart Drag, and local-first boundaries intact.

## Shell intake

- The per-user Installer registers a static **Send to DropSpace** Explorer verb
  and a **DropSpace** shortcut under the user's SendTo folder. Both invoke the
  installed executable directly and require neither elevation nor a shell
  extension DLL. Portable remains registration-free.
- Explorer and SendTo use one typed, bounded `--shell-add --source ... --`
  contract. Unicode and quoted paths are preserved, oversized or malformed
  input fails closed, and accepted items become normal Temporary Space records
  without moving/copying source files or writing Clipboard History.
- The existing AppInstance owner handles redirected shell activation before
  the normal foreground path. The main window is not activated; a brief,
  localized Dynamic Island acknowledgement contains no file names or paths.

## Custom Quick Actions

- File, Image, Text, and URL profiles can each use Automatic ordering or a
  validated custom order of up to three unique actions.
- The existing `IItemActionRegistry` remains the only action authority.
  Unavailable configured actions are skipped without random replacement, and
  the remaining available registry actions stay in More. Main and Dynamic
  Island projections share the same policy.
- Settings migration v10 to v11 defaults every profile to Automatic and the
  safe UI reset preserves non-UI preferences.

## Undo and persistence

- Remove item/batch, clear unpinned Clipboard history, and pin/unpin actions
  share one eight-second Undo slot. A new action finalizes the previous slot;
  `Ctrl+Z`, the InfoBar button, and the Dynamic Island surface use the same
  state.
- SQLite schema 3 marks pending removals transactionally, hides them from
  ordinary queries, and restores exact records on Undo. Expiry, startup
  recovery, shutdown, and finalization delete only unreferenced DropSpace-owned
  payloads; original source files are never touched.

## Validation and evidence boundary

- The release workflow is authoritative for localization parity, Windows
  compatibility, Core/Infrastructure tests, WinUI build, Portable EXE, MSIX,
  installer lifecycle, smoke tests, checksums, update metadata, Release
  assets, and website/API synchronization.
- New tests cover the bounded shell parser, Quick Action ordering and recovery,
  pending-delete migration/Undo/finalization, payload sharing, and external
  source-file safety.

This Preview is **CONDITIONAL** until hosted Windows CI and the real Explorer
context-menu, SendTo multi-selection, no-focus startup, installer upgrade and
uninstall, DPI, and manual Undo matrix have executable evidence. Linux static
checks and source inspection do not substitute for that matrix. Public Preview
assets may be unsigned; verify `SHA256SUMS.txt` and download only from this
GitHub Release.

## 中文说明

- Preview.9 新增安装器提供的当前用户 Explorer“发送到 DropSpace”和 SendTo
  集成；Portable 保持免注册。Shell 入站使用有界参数协议，不提权、不移动或复制源文件、不写入剪贴板历史，也不会激活主窗口。
- 文件、图片、文本和网址分别支持 Automatic 或最多三个唯一自定义 Quick
  Actions；不可用动作会被跳过，More 继续来自现有能力注册表，主窗口和灵动岛使用同一套规则。
- 删除项目、批量删除、清理未固定剪贴板记录以及固定/取消固定共享一个八秒 Undo
  槽位。待删除记录可恢复；过期或最终提交只清理未被引用的 DropSpace 自有 payload，不会触碰源文件。
- 本版本发布结果为 **CONDITIONAL（有条件完成）**：Windows CI 和 Explorer、SendTo、安装器、DPI、启动及人工 Undo 矩阵仍需真实证据，Linux 检查不能替代这些验证。

Stable-channel users will not receive this Preview. Select the Preview
channel only to test the new shell, Quick Actions, and Undo behavior.
